rows.grounds: compound of karuṇā (compassion) and sudhā (nectar), expressing the means of sprinkling

items.question: What compassionate consecration and stabilization does the supplicant request from the addressed deity?
premises: The deity is directly addressed as the agent of the actions.
The supplicant requests to be sprinkled with compassion-nectar.
The supplicant requests to be made steady.
items.inference: The deity is petitioned to consecrate and stabilize the supplicant through compassionate grace.
items.plain_english: You, sprinkle me with the nectar of compassion and make me steady.
